newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Tuesday, issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and they are annual percentage rates.
The central bank does not post volumes.
Traders said the rates went down today with non-bank financial insitutions joining state-run banks to lend out of money on the market.
The rates have been on a firm downtrend with state-run banks lending out large amounts of money since August 23 when the People's Bank of China cut bank interest rates, they said.

"Some financial institutions still have large amounts of money to offer, but with the negative impact of the interest rate cut gradually digested, the market rates will stabilise in the short term," one trader said.
